section.title: Daily fluid estimate
section.description: Rough guideline for drinking water and other fluids—not a prescription. Needs vary with health conditions, medications, training load, and climate.

errors.range: Weight should be between 20 and 300 kg.
Weight is outside the supported range.

sex.label: Sex (for baseline)
sex.help: Adjusts ml per kg slightly using common population heuristics. Choose unspecified if you prefer a middle value.

activity.label: Activity level
activity.help: Extra fluid added on top of the weight-based estimate.

pregnancy.label: Pregnancy or breastfeeding
pregnancy.help: If applicable. Adds a fixed daily amount; follow your clinician for medical guidance.

status.empty: Enter a valid weight to see an estimate.
status.incomplete: Check your weight is within range.

section.title: Your estimate
section.description: Round numbers for planning; drink when thirsty and adjust with activity and heat.

empty.body: Fill in weight and tap Calculate, or adjust inputs to update live.

disclaimer.title: Important
disclaimer.body: This tool is for general education only. It is not medical advice. People with heart, kidney, or liver disease, electrolyte disorders, or on fluid-restricted plans should follow a clinician’s guidance.

method.title: Method
method.description: Simple transparent model you can sanity-check:

points.weight: Base volume is body weight times a ml-per-kg factor (31–35 depending on sex bucket, or 33 if unspecified).
points.addons: Fixed daily amounts are added for activity tier, hot climate, and pregnancy or breastfeeding when selected.
points.round: The total is rounded to the nearest milliliter for display.
